text:
Maya: Heads up — 3 visitors at 3:15pm today. One needs accessible seating and one is bringing two big parcels. Can we badge them and make room on the couch? Also their courier left the packages unlabelled.
Sven: Names?
Maya: Guests are: Dr. Kaur, Jordan Lim, and 'Studio Rep' (company name on the invite). Dr. Kaur needs wheelchair access.
FrontDeskBot: Visitor check-in created: 3 badges (Dr. Kaur, Jordan Lim, Studio Rep). Badges will be at the desk by 3:05pm. Badge IDs: BK-431, BK-432, BK-433.
Lena: Couch is pretty full at 3pm. We can clear the middle section — does someone want to swap? @Arjun can you take the bench near the windows?
Arjun: I can move to the bench. Also I can sign for parcels if needed. Where should parcels go? Locker? Reception?
Maya: Please put them in 'Visitor Holds' on the shelving unit and mark with the guest name. One box is labeled 'samples' but the other has no label. If someone can add a note: `unlabelled box — confirm recipient at check-in` that would help.
Sven: I'll add a sticky note and take a pic to the #people-ops thread in case we need proof. :camera:
Lena: +1 for putting them on shelf A (Visitor Holds). I'll print an extra badge lanyard and flag the accessible seat.
FrontDeskBot: Reminder — courier deliveries after 5pm should go to Loading Dock B; this one logged as immediate. :package:
Maya: Thanks folks! @Lena @Arjun @Sven appreciate the quick help. :heart:
Jordan (not a Redwood user): ETA says 3:12 from the lobby — they texted front desk.
Lena: Perfect, I'll meet them at the desk and escort Dr. Kaur to the accessible table. Anyone want the ukulele? (kidding) :smile:
Arjun: I'll be at the window bench in 2 min to move my laptop. :thumbsup:
Sven: Photo of the unlabelled box posted in thread → (uploaded).
Maya: All set. Closing the loop — badges picked up 3:04pm, guests checked in 3:14pm, parcels labelled 'Studio Rep' and 'Dr. Kaur' and moved to shelf A.
FrontDeskBot: Thread closed by Maya.
